leads.Personalized Subject Line: A modern Jonah and a modern Job: an idea for your retellings
leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi Michele,

My name is Roland Jacobs. I'm a designer and book services specialist who helps authors present, publish, and promote their books.

While looking into Christian Indie Award titles I found The Runaway Prophet and The Faithful One. What caught my attention was how you turn Jonah's flight into the story of Rory Justice, an ad executive carrying a sealed letter from his dying father, and how The Faithful One brings Job's story into a contemporary setting.

Because your five novels share one clear idea (modern versions of Bible stories), I think a 12-month book marketing roadmap could help them work as a set: a calendar that moves readers from one retelling to the next, ties releases and promotions to seasons in the church year, and makes good use of the newsletter you already run.

If it would be useful, I could draft a one-page sample roadmap for these two titles at no cost, so you can see the approach before deciding anything.

Would you like to see it?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs

leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi Tracy,

I'm Roland Jacobs, a designer and book services specialist. I help authors present and promote their books.

I came across Child of Prophecy and Child of Destiny while reading about Christian speculative fiction finalists. Two things stood out to me: a heroine whose synesthesia lets her punch a hole into another world, and a sequel where a girl holding all three factors of magic ends up at the centre of a coming civil war.

You already have a newsletter and a street team, so my suggestion is a 12-month book marketing roadmap for the Divide series. It would use the free-feeling prequel Dragon Between Worlds as an entry point, then plan seasonal pushes for each book and street-team activities so new readers move through the series in order.

I'd be glad to sketch a short complimentary outline built around these two books if that sounds useful.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs

leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi Marcia,

My name is Roland Jacobs, and I work as a designer and book services specialist, helping authors present and promote their books.

I found your work through the InScribe members' books pages and then read about Flecks of Gold and Pebble's Bond on your site. Congratulations on fully funding the Yukon memoir. I also liked the setup of Pebble's Bond, where a girl who has lost everything is accidentally tethered to a flying Chevan, which is forbidden.

Since Flecks of Gold is moving from crowdfunding to a wider launch, a focused book promotion and marketing plan could help it reach readers past your backers. I'd suggest a launch sequence that uses your Substack serial readers and blog followers, plus a few Yukon-themed visuals for social posts.

I'd be happy to put together a short complimentary concept for the launch so you can see the direction.

Would that be helpful?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs
